summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 24, 2026, along with amended Memorandum and Articles of Association approved by special resolution. The filing is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation. It discloses share capital structure, including ordinary, redeemable deferred, and preferred shares, but no transaction, strategic review, or event-based action. Accordingly, this is classified as a non-special-situation filing.
